app_fee.value: The application fee is $30 U.S., non-refundable, for all graduate applicants.
app_fee.quote: There is a non-refundable application fee of $30 U.S. dollars.

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate School may waive the $30 fee for applicants in financial need, usually on FAFSA-based criteria. The page does not say whether international applicants qualify.
fee_waiver.quote: Applicants demonstrating financial need may have the application fee of $30 USD waived by the Graduate School

gre_general.value: The graduate school sets no single rule; GRE requirements are set by each program, so see the program records.
gre_general.quote: Some graduate programs at FIU require the GRE exam or even the GMAT.

toefl_min.value: A TOEFL iBT score of 4.5 on the new scale is the minimum for tests taken from January 21, 2026.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT/PBT:4.5 on the iBT TOEFL

also.quote: for tests taken prior to this date, the required minimum score is 80 on the iBT

english_waiver.value: India is not on FIU's list of English-proficiency exempt countries, so Indian applicants need a test score. The page does not mention English-medium degrees.
english_waiver.quote: English Proficiency Exempt Countries | Antigua and Barbuda ... Zimbabwe

notes: Fee waiver: the Graduate School waives the $30 fee for financial need (FAFSA-based, per the Psychology page); no international-specific waiver was found. TOEFL: 4.5 on the new scale from 21 Jan 2026, 80 before. Some doctoral programs set higher English minimums (see program records).
